Alice (Acme): Hey team — our tool call to /v1/tools/run keeps returning 400 'Invalid JSON in tool args'. Works for simple payloads but fails when path contains backslashes. Repro below.

Alice (Acme): curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tools/run -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\"tool\":\"upload\",\"args\":\"{\\\"path\\\":\\\"C:\\\\Users\\\\alice\\\\docs\\\\report.pdf\\\",}\"}'

Elaine - Support: thanks, can you paste the exact JSON body you sent (unwrapped) and the SDK/client you used?

Alice (Acme): Node SDK 1.8.3. Full body I sent (shown raw):
```{
  "tool": "upload",
  "args": "{\"path\":\"C:\\Users\\alice\\docs\\report.pdf\",}"
}
```

Elaine - Support: ah — two things jump out: 1) your client is double-stringifying the args field (args is a string containing JSON), and 2) there's a trailing comma inside that inner JSON string which makes it invalid. The server tries to parse the inner string as JSON and fails.

Jordan - Eng: I repro'd this exact payload locally. Parser errors at the inner JSON: unexpected token '}' after trailing comma. Sample error: `Unexpected token } in JSON at position 39`. Repro steps: send above payload to /v1/tools/run using curl or the SDK and you'll get 400 + parser message.

Elaine - Support: short-term workaround: send args as an object (not a double-encoded string). Example that works:
```{
  "tool": "upload",
  "args": {
    "path": "C:\\Users\\alice\\docs\\report.pdf"
  }
}
```

Alice (Acme): Confirmed — switching to object form fixed it. Thanks.

Alice (Acme): Curious: why do some clients double-stringify? Our internal helper was doing `JSON.stringify(args)` then embedding into the request body string, which ended up adding escapes and left the trailing comma from a sloppy toString.

Jordan - Eng: sounds like a client bug. From platform side, we can improve diagnostics: return a clearer error when inner-string parsing fails (point out trailing commas / unescaped backslashes). I'll file ENG-1274 and include a repro.

SupportBot: Ticket CUST-4021 created and linked to ENG-1274; priority P2, assignee: Jordan - Eng.

Elaine - Support: leaving a note for docs team to add an SDK checklist: avoid double-stringifying args; prefer sending objects.

Alice (Acme): Appreciate it — workaround deployed, will patch client. Thanks :pray:

Jordan - Eng: quick follow-up: we'll also add a server-side guard that rejects `args` when it's a string containing JSON with trailing commas and return a 422 with a diagnostic string. ETA next patch release.
